First I apologize if me asking for beta testers here bothers anyone. Let me know if I should remove the post.

What's the app and what does it do? The app is Web Video Caster. It allows you to send videos from websites to your TV. So for example you go to vimeo.com and you find a video and then the app will send it to your TV. Until now it has only worked with the Chromecast but this beta includes support for SmartTVs, DLNA renderers, AppleTV, Roku (very basic support), and others.

How do I signup for the beta? Join this G+ community and once in there follow the opt-in link on the pinned post to get the beta. Sometimes it takes Google a few minutes to sync everything so the opt-in link might not work instantly. Sorry this is kind of painful but that is the way Google wants us to do betas.

Before anyone asks, yes it does work with a lot of artful nudity websites and no it does not support flash at this time. Live streams and authenticated videos are supported on most cases (probably not Roku for now).

Please feel free to post any questions or PM me or email me, I'll be answering as quickly as possible. Also I will be approving community sign-ups in batches so it might take a few hours.

Thank you.

I'd like to partner with a small team of people to help write the code that decentralizes Voat. The best part, it doesn't involve any changes to Voat's servers at all.

Here's how it works:

Community hosted servers use Voat's API to fetch, say, 100 posts, from the top 100 most popular subverses. It would do that every 5 minutes or so, storing it in a MySQL database. These numbers would be configurable by the user hosting the server.

A simple web server would connect to the MySQL database and display it, exactly the way it would look on Voat. CSS for each of these subverses would be fetched daily, and stored on the web server to be served to make sure there is no difference between the look of Voat and of these servers.

We could put up a new subverse, allowing people to post their servers there. The advantage to hosting a server would be to allow you to add a little bit to the HTML, like ads, perhaps. People who edited it too much would get downvoted to the bottom of that subverse - The community would decide which servers were good and which were bad.

We need programmers. I would like to put myself in charge of the backend, fetching the subverses and posts.
I've got the basics worked out to allow anyone to help host Voat, but I need programmers to make it happen.
